name: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant
description: A famous fried chicken restaurant that opened in 1934, just outside the park gate and open without a park ticket. Known for fried chicken dinners with mashed potatoes and biscuits, chicken pot pie and boysenberry pie. Reservations via OpenTable. Prices here are estimates.

items.name: Fried Chicken Dinner
items.description: Fried chicken with mashed potatoes and biscuits

name: Fireman's BBQ
description: An open-air barbecue in Ghost Town serving BBQ chicken, ribs and a giant turkey leg. Its current opening status is unconfirmed and hours vary. Prices here are estimates.

name: Boardwalk BBQ
description: A cafeteria-style smokehouse serving pulled pork, smokehouse sausages and rotisserie chicken, with sides such as mac and cheese and cornbread. Prices here are estimates.

name: Ghost Town Bakery
description: A bakery and coffee shop in Ghost Town, directly across from GhostRider, serving fresh cinnamon buns, soup in a sourdough bread bowl and stuffed croissants. Prices here are estimates.

items.name: Soup in a Bread Bowl
items.description: Soup served in a sourdough bowl
